name: corpus
description: Find exact source passages and preserve reusable context with source links.

interface.shortDescription: Find sources and carry linked context forward
interface.longDescription: Corpus finds the original file, message, or completed agent task behind information used in a project, then preserves selected context with links back to those sources. It reads only registered sources, keeps personal indexes and context on this Mac, and leaves original documents and provider records unchanged. Archived contexts remain readable; destructive context purge is not provided.
defaultPrompt: Show my registered collections, indexing coverage, and reusable context.
Find the original sources and passages I need for this task.
Continue this selected context and show what changed since the last review.
